json_ld_descriptions: KRLG Injury Lawyers is an Arizona personal injury law firm representing accident and injury victims in Phoenix, Scottsdale, and throughout Maricopa County. The firm handles car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, rideshare (Uber/Lyft) accidents, construction accidents, product liability, and wrongful death claims. With over 100 years of combined experience and more than $250 million recovered for clients, KRLG Injury Lawyers offers free consultations on a contingency fee basis and is available 24/7.

KRLG Injury Lawyers is a personal injury law firm founded in 2023 by co-founders Austin Kurtz and Brian Riley, representing accident and injury victims throughout Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Maricopa County, Arizona. With over 100 years of combined experience, the firm handles car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, rideshare (Uber/Lyft) accidents, construction accidents, product liability, and wrongful death cases. KRLG Injury Lawyers has recovered over $250 million for clients and offers free consultations on a contingency fee basis.
